summary: Iteration 18: Frontend testing of Trips (Рейсы) functionality in Logistics page. All features working correctly - trip creation, order assignment, driver/status changes, order removal from trip, trip deletion with orders returning to general list. All three categories (Теплицы, Купели, Сауны) have nested Заказы/Рейсы tabs.

issues: Status dropdown options (Активен, Доставлен, Отменён) may have overlay click issues in some cases - works but requires force=True click

critical_code_review_comments: Trips functionality well implemented with proper state management
Orders correctly marked with tripId when added to trip and tripId removed when removed from trip
Counters update correctly in real-time (orders count, trips count, badges)
Google Maps deprecation warning for Marker - consider migrating to AdvancedMarkerElement in future
seed_data_creation: Created test trip 'Тестовый рейс T1' during testing, deleted after verification
context_for_next_testing_agent: Trips (Рейсы) functionality fully tested and working. Each category (Теплицы, Купели, Сауны) has nested tabs: Заказы (orders without trip) and Рейсы (trips list). Trip creation modal allows selecting orders and optionally assigning driver. Trip details panel shows driver selector, status selector, orders list with remove buttons, and delete trip button. One existing trip 'Рейс на Варшаву' in Купели category with 2 orders.

nested_tabs_structure.details: All 3 categories (Теплицы, Купели, Сауны) have Заказы and Рейсы inner tabs

trip_creation.details: Select orders → Click 'Создать рейс' → Fill name → Optionally select driver → Create. Orders disappear from general list.

trip_details_view.details: Shows trip name, driver selector, status selector, orders list with addresses and phones

driver_assignment.details: Driver dropdown works, shows 'Рейс обновлён' toast, driver name appears in trip card

status_change.details: Status dropdown shows options: Активен, Доставлен, Отменён

remove_order_from_trip.details: X button removes order from trip, order returns to general list, 'Заказ убран из рейса' toast

delete_trip.details: Delete button with confirmation, all orders return to general list, 'Рейс удалён' toast

counters_update.details: Orders count, trips count, and badges update correctly in real-time
